subject: Emulation scheduler migration
interpretation: Accepted status mirrors the human-reviewed source checklist. A passing virtual Weston job does not establish physical Hyprland, audible speakers, gamepad, or production cutover.

milestones.title: clock and ownership foundation
milestones.acceptance_scope: checklist-backed; unverified physical acceptance remains pending

tasks.text: ⏱️ Move deadline pacing into `scheduler.rs` with a dedicated OS thread.
🎮 Give the worker exclusive ownership of a generic machine object.
🖼️ Replace an unbounded video queue with a one-frame mailbox.
💤 Add independent Play, Focus, Background-pause and Speed commands.
🛑 Make a failed emulation frame halt the worker and expose its error.
📦 Bound outstanding asynchronous operations to 128 without blocking the GUI or losing separately ordered policy commands.
🧪 Confirm format, Clippy and full workspace tests on code commit `d0254a7` (CI run 39951239026).
🖥️ Verify worker scheduling while Hyprland is off-workspace or occluded.

milestones.title: thread-owned frontend session
milestones.acceptance_scope: source-only; physical Hyprland and production default are separately gated

tasks.text: 🧠 Define `OwnedSession` wrapping `FrontendSession` in `session_engine.rs`.
🎵 Produce PCM on the worker and enqueue it to the existing bounded Rodio worker.
💾 Serialize quick saves, durable slots and SRAM operations on the worker.
⏳ Flush SRAM periodically on the worker and at manual/background pause transitions, independent of UI redraws.
🎮 Publish an atomic held-controller state with latched short-press edges.
🖼️ Skip unnecessary RGBA copies after 300 ms without UI repaint heartbeats, even when Wayland never reports the window as minimized.
📬 Expose typed ROM, save, cheat, audio and input command methods.
🖼️ Build a renderer-only adapter that consumes published snapshots and updates egui textures.
⌨️ Expire stale input heartbeat after missing window callbacks, preventing endlessly held keys.
💾 Publish restored still frames after quick-save and disk-state loads, including while paused.
🎮 Support nonblocking ROM replacement with old-game preservation after failed cartridge loads.
📸 Share an owned screenshot payload with the established frontend instead of borrowing emulator pixels from the UI.
🔊 Publish actual audio-device, submitted PCM, and dropped-buffer diagnostics alongside video frames.
💾 Run final SRAM flush and PCM invalidation on the emulation owner thread before shutdown/join.
📬 Process command bursts in bounded batches; surface fatal worker exits and queue cheat/save commands without stalling UI frames.

🔄 Replace all live `StarbyteApp.session` access in opt-in worker mode with worker commands and snapshots. Optional legacy session is never constructed with the worker; bridge reads published state without fallback. CI 40032643086 verified Linux, Windows and original-window native Weston, including owner finalization.

📊 Move opt-in original-window emulation telemetry (FPS, frame gaps, overlays) to worker-produced truth, with separately labeled renderer delivery and texture submission measurements and bounded asynchronous owner-job depth (CI 40030994642). Production default cutover remains separate.

🎚️ Preserve current speed/pitch/mute/volume control semantics across sound modes through the opt-in original-app worker handoff (worker command test and pitch-mode mapping, CI 40011629443; physical audibility separately gated).

milestones.title: opt-in threaded preview parity
milestones.acceptance_scope: checklist-backed; unverified physical acceptance remains pending

tasks.text: 🖼️ Display coalesced worker frames using egui textures without advancing the emulator from UI redraws.
🎮 Reuse configured twelve-button keyboard bindings and support several gamepads with analog D-pad emulation.
⏱️ Follow configured playback speed and independent audio-pitch defaults.
💤 Apply background pause and compositor heartbeat policies separately from manual Pause.
💾 Route memory quick saves/loads and three persistent disk slots through worker ownership.
📬 Queue preview saves and loads asynchronously to avoid freezing menus.
📸 Capture screenshots through the worker and write PNG files on a separate I/O thread.
📊 Show actual worker FPS, hitches, CPU time and superseded video-frame counts.
🎚️ Add worker-controlled mute, audio enable, volume and independent pitch-mode selectors.
🧩 Honor the existing individual View → Status bar metric visibility choices.
📂 Open a replacement cartridge asynchronously without blocking menus or discarding the old game on load failure.
🔉 Add real device/sink diagnostics and a mute-aware 440 Hz speaker check.
🎮 Show worker-produced hardware input and cheat-interception diagnostics.
⏩ Use Tab for temporary configured fast-forward speed, with transition-only audio/scheduler updates.
🛡️ Release stale gamepad holds on lost compositor focus and expose a worker-owned clear-cheats action.
📚 Start the opt-in preview with no cartridge, browse installed games from the real asynchronous library index, and launch each selected ROM/ZIP plus matching cheats on the sole emulation owner.
🔎 Search the installed library while rendering only visible rows; disable save/pause controls until a cartridge is installed.
🎼 Verify actual background audio quality and speaker/device recovery on Hyprland.
🧪 Verify preview menus, gamepads, screenshots and save slots natively on Hyprland.
✅ Confirm format, compile, Clippy and native Weston preview smoke at code commit `d0254a7`.

milestones.title: native GUI migration
milestones.acceptance_scope: checklist-backed; unverified physical acceptance remains pending

tasks.text: 🧱 Introduce frontend-neutral SessionControlsSnapshot and migrate the existing disk-slot menu to it; worker can serialize the same summary.
🎮 Migrate the existing input overlay to frontend-neutral SessionInputDiagnostics that the worker can also publish.
📸 Migrate the existing screenshot action to a shared owned SessionScreenshot payload that the worker can capture as well.
🔊 Use shared frontend PCM metrics and sound diagnostics in both legacy app and worker, without direct emulator access from ordinary menus.
🛡️ Isolate deep blackout-monitor emulator inspection behind the FrontendSession boundary for later migration into worker ownership.
💾 Route the established F5/F8 and durable-slot actions through frontend-neutral SessionSaveAction; the worker uses the same action dispatcher for quick save/load, durable slots and SRAM.
🖼️ Share validated nearest-filtered RGBA texture uploads between the legacy player and threaded preview, without adding an intermediate copy to the legacy loop.

🎬 Share one typed ROM launch request (resolved path, sound/save mode and matching cheats) across library, direct-file, startup, sound-mode restart and worker APIs, without executing a frame between installation and cheat selection.
🎬 Route game-launch success/error replies through the emulation worker, with native full-window Weston failure/survivor acceptance (CI 40013247831).

⌨️ Send controller inputs without losing key-down/up edges; preserve F5/F8/F9/Escape. Native original-window key-event smoke and actual SNES joypad press/release regression passed (CI 40015689046, 40002095002).
🪟 Display the latest completed RGBA texture without blocking the worker (opt-in full library, Weston catch-up after a two-second callback gap, CI 40009459833).
🏠 Keep the full library, menus, recent covers and View status-bar toggles intact (opt-in original-window Weston acceptance, CI 40021161371).
⏸️ Keep manual Pause, automatic focus pause, background-allowed gameplay and their resumes independent (original full-library Weston, CI 40011629443).

💾 Preserve original disk-slot, SRAM and sound-mode namespaces. Native original-window persistent/compatibility slot switch, disk/quick save/restore and battery SRAM restart tests passed (CI 40015689046, 40000854342).
🧹 Complete the opt-in original-window worker shutdown handoff: stop clock, flush SRAM, clear audio and join exactly once (CI 40016711374; production-default cutover remains separately gated).
🚀 Make the worker the default runtime only after passing acceptance gates.

milestones.title: validation
milestones.acceptance_scope: checklist-backed; unverified physical acceptance remains pending

tasks.text: 🧪 Add a display-server-free, real built-in ROM smoke path (`--demo --scheduler-smoke`) to CI.
🖥️ Add an opt-in `--threaded-preview` native egui shell and Weston smoke that requires a rendered texture.
🧪 Add a `cargo test` built-in demo ROM integration test for background frames, hidden-window copy suppression and reappearance, neutral controls, screenshot capture and quick-save state.
🎬 Add direct/worker launch-request tests for failed ROM preservation, restored save-mode namespaces and memory quick-save invalidation after a successful ROM replacement.
🔗 Add a compositor-free integration test from an installed library entry through ROM materialization, exclusive worker launch, unfocused gameplay frames and a worker-owned quick save.
✅ Confirm Linux CI format/Clippy and Linux+Windows tests pass on `d0254a7`.
🟩 Confirm the headless scheduler smoke and both native Weston smokes complete on `d0254a7`.

🎮 Test the opt-in library selection coordinator from installed entry through asynchronous ROM preparation, owned-session launch, still-frame upload and compositor-independent frame progress (Linux test run on `adddfa9`).
🪟 Add and pass a dedicated native Weston smoke for `--threaded-preview --exit-after-library-scan` without a startup ROM, with a real indexed built-in SNES demo file (Linux CI run 39955310386).

🎮 Add and pass native Weston indexed-library game launch: scan the local demo, select the installed entry through the ROM preparation worker, install it on the exclusive SNES worker, and upload 30 rendered egui frames (`STARBYTE_THREADED_LIBRARY_PLAY_SMOKE_OK`; run 39959433627).

🌙 In native Weston, suppress egui callback work and heartbeats for two seconds with background pause disabled; verify the worker advances at least 45 independent frames (observed 121 on commit `135cf2e`, run 39962498642).
🪟 Run Wayland window visible/focused and confirm accurate ~60.1 emulated FPS.
🌌 Switch to another Hyprland workspace; confirm continued emulation and sound when allowed.
💤 Repeat with background pause checked; verify true stop, no catch-up burst and clean resume.
🛡️ Confirm manual Pause, gamepad, cheats, screenshot, quick/disk saves and SRAM across restarts.
